mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_reservation (res_id, bno, userid, res_date, start_time, end_time, status, regdate) VALUES (seq_reservation.NEXTVAL, #{bno}, #{userid}, #{resDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT res_id AS resId, bno AS bno, userid AS userid, res_date AS resDate, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status AS status, regdate AS regdate FROM tbl_reservation WHERE userid = #{userid} ORDER BY res_date DESC, start_time DESC

SELECT res_id AS resId, bno AS bno, userid AS userid, res_date AS resDate, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status AS status, regdate AS regdate FROM tbl_reservation WHERE res_id = #{resId}
SELECT * FROM tbl_reservation ORDER BY res_date DESC, start_time DESC

SELECT bno, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RESERVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reservedCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCnt FROM tbl_reservation GROUP BY bno ORDER BY bno
